section_summary.extract_value: This section reports confirmatory and exploratory factor analyses of the 13-item Body Appreciation Scale (BAS) in a single study (total N = 591) that was randomly split into two subsamples (n = 296 and n = 295). A two-factor solution ('General Body Appreciation' and 'Body Image Investment') was retained with adequate fit, and multi-group invariance testing found the two-factor structure to be invariant across Malay (n = 315) and Chinese (n = 276) participants.
